title: Low-Dimensional Adaptation of Rectified Flow: A Diffusion and Stochastic Localization Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2601.15500v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In recent years, Rectified flow (RF) has gained considerable popularity largely due to its generation efficiency and state-of-the-art performance. In this paper, we investigate how well RF automatically adapts to the intrinsic low dimensionality of the support of the target distribution to accelerate sampling. We show that, using a carefully designed end-point adapted time-discretization scheme and with sufficiently accurate drift estimates, the RF sampler enjoys an iteration complexity of order $O(k/\varepsilon)$ (up to log factors), where $\varepsilon$ is the precision in total variation distance and $k$ is the intrinsic dimension of the target distribution. In addition, we show that the denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) procedure is equivalent to a stochastic version of RF by establishing a novel connection between these processes and stochastic localization. translated_title: 整流流的低维自适应：基于扩散与随机定位的视角
translated_abstract: 近年来，整流流凭借其生成效率和最先进的性能而广受欢迎。在本文中，我们研究了整流流如何自动适应目标分布支撑集的内在低维性，从而加速采样过程。我们证明，使用精心设计的端点自适应时间离散化方案以及足够精确的漂移估计，整流流采样器可以获得 O(k/ε) 量级的迭代复杂度（在对数因子范围内），其中 ε 是总变差距离下的精度，k 是目标分布的内在维度。此外，我们通过在整流流与随机定位过程之间建立一种新颖的联系，证明了去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）过程等价于整流流的随机化版本。基于这一联系，我们进一步设计了一种随……
tldr: 本文证明整流流能自动适应目标分布的内在低维结构，在端点自适应时间离散化方案下达到 O(k/ε) 的采样迭代复杂度，并建立了DDPM与随机定位之间的新颖联系，证明DDPM等价于整流流的随机化版本。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that rectified flow automatically adapts to the intrinsic low dimensionality of the target distribution, achieving O(k/ε) sampling iteration complexity with an end-point adapted time-discretization scheme, while establishing a novel connection showing that DDPM is equivalent to a stochastic version of rectified flow via stochastic localization.
